title: Authorized fees
text:
19.60.010 Authorized fees.
The city department charged with administering this Title 19 is authorized to charge fees for all services provided under this Title 19 including but not limited to fees for any review of plans, review of documents, inspections, application review, application processing, and permit issuance. All fees shall be in the amount authorized by city council in the annual budget resolution adopted by city council.
(Ord. No. 19078, § 1, 8-4-2020)
